children: The UK Maritime Trade Operations Office said on October 31 that unauthorized individuals boarded a large fishing vessel on the 30th local time, and authorities were concerned the incident could be linked to a piracy gang. According to Sina Finance, citing the UK Maritime Trade Operations Office, the location was not specified, and relevant authorities are investigating.

title: UK Maritime Trade Operations Office: Unauthorized Individuals Board Large Fishing Vessel
